name: _lu_with_info
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_lu_with_info(Tensor self, bool pivot=True, bool check_errors=True) -> (Tensor LU, Tensor pivots, Tensor info). Computes a packed LU factorization, one-indexed int32 pivots and an int32 status tensor. Coverage validates pivoted and supported non-pivoted factorization by reconstruction, singular and empty matrices, empty batch dimensions, status shapes, check_errors, exact-zero pivot reporting and the distinction between zero and non-finite pivots. The private upstream leading underscore is the canonical base; the repository artifact ID remains lu_with_info. Inputs are not mutated and outputs do not alias self.
